thread.title_full: CoreAge Rx Unveils Bounce Back Restorative Copper Peptide Cream to Boost Skin Firmness and Barrier Health

author: Newport Daily Express
title: CoreAge Rx Unveils Bounce Back Restorative Copper Peptide Cream to Boost Skin Firmness and Barrier Health
text:
Nighttime repair cream features a 0.2% copper peptide formulation to support natural overnight skin recovery.
CoreAge Rx, a provider of virtual healthcare and personalized wellness solutions, today announced the launch of Bounce Back, a specialized restorative repair cream formulated to improve skin firmness, reinforce barrier function, and smooth the appearance of fine lines. Designed to complement the body's natural nocturnal repair cycle, the new prescription topical provides rich hydration in a lightweight format suitable for nightly use.
At the heart of the Bounce Back formulation is a 0.2% concentration of copper peptides, an active compound recognized for its ability to encourage skin resilience and support structural elasticity. Developed by dermatologists and compounded in the United States, the cream works overnight to help repair daily environmental wear, strengthen the natural moisture barrier, and restore a smoother, firmer complexion over time.
Because Bounce Back contains active, prescription-grade ingredients, access to the cream is managed through the CoreAge Rx telehealth portal. Patients complete a confidential online health assessment, which is subsequently evaluated by a US board-certified physician to confirm medical appropriateness. Upon approval, patients are advised to apply a thin layer to clean, dry skin each evening, adjusting frequency based on personal skin tolerance as recommended by their clinician. Consistent daytime sunscreen application is strongly encouraged throughout the regimen.
CoreAge Rx offers Bounce Back starting at $64.99 per month. This transparent pricing model covers the initial online medical evaluation, the compounded prescription product, and fast, complimentary home shipping; all delivered without mandatory membership fees, hidden add-ons, or long-term contractual commitments.
The introduction of Bounce Back expands CoreAge Rx’s holistic approach to targeted skincare and longevity. Alongside prescription therapies, platform members gain access to continuous provider follow-ups, 24/7 dedicated support, and an interactive patient community focused on wellness goals.
To learn more about how copper peptides support collagen synthesis and skin recovery during sleep, read the detailed feature on CoreAge Rx Introduces Bounce Back, a Restorative Nighttime Copper Peptide Cream for Visible Firmness and Skin Barrier Repair .
For complete product details or to start an online consultation, visit https://www.coreagerx.com/product/bounce-back/
About CoreAge Rx
CoreAge Rx is a digital health platform that pairs virtual physician consultations with direct consumer delivery of prescription treatments and daily functional supplements. By providing accessible care options across metabolic wellness, preventive longevity, and targeted dermatology, CoreAge Rx delivers practical health solutions designed to fit naturally into everyday life.
For more information about Bounce Back and other skincare offerings, visit coreagerx.com
